scene_harper_00_intro.text:
Harper Vale — instantly recognizable, magnetic in person — stands in a warm halo of lanternlight near a wide loft window, the city sprawled in glittering layers below. She swirls her drink, watching reflections glide across the glass and polished game tables nearby.

"You look like someone with better stories than half the people here," she says with a sly, cinematic smile.

Her voice is low, velvet-smooth — the kind of tone that makes everything sound like a line delivered perfectly on the first take.

scene_harper_soft_01.text:
You close the distance between you slowly, giving her space to lean in if she wants to. She does — her shoulder brushes yours, light as a whisper.

"Slow burn, huh?" she murmurs. "Dangerous choice. I tend to enjoy those."

Her perfume is warm, elegant, with a hint of something darker beneath it. The lanternlight catches her eyes just right — soft, inviting.

scene_harper_spicy_01.text:
You match her gaze with an energy she wasn’t expecting. Her brows lift, amused.

She steps closer — far closer than the polite radius of celebrity distance. "Oh," she says, voice dropping, "you’re bold. That’s rare around here. Most people are too afraid to approach me like a real person." 

Her smile turns sharper. "Show me you can keep up."

scene_harper_tame_01.text:
You offer a genuine compliment — nothing heavy, nothing suggestive. Just honest appreciation.

Harper pauses, caught off guard in the best way. "You know… very few people talk to me like I’m a person first." She laughs softly. "It’s refreshing. Really."

She leans against the railing beside you, watching the skyline glow.

scene_harper_fail_01.text:
Harper gives you a polite, warm smile — but the spark doesn’t quite catch.

"It’s alright," she says softly. "Not every scene needs a dramatic payoff. Enjoy the party, okay?" She touches your arm gently, then slips back into the crowd.

scene_harper_success_private_01.text:
Harper takes your hand — deliberate, confident — and guides you toward a dim side balcony hidden behind a velvet curtain.

"I like the way you move," she whispers. "Come with me. Let’s step out of the spotlight for a bit."

scene_harper_success_private_02.text:
Harper exhales a laugh that sounds almost dangerous. "God, finally someone who doesn’t crumble when I push back."

She nods toward a secluded circular viewing platform where the party lights dim to darkness.
"Come on," she says. "I want to see what else you’re fearless about."

scene_harper_success_tame_01.text:
She smiles in a way that’s softer than any performance she’s ever given on screen.

"This is nice," she says simply. "No scripts. No pressure. Just… this." She nudges you gently with her shoulder.

"Stay with me a little longer?"
